bridge.narrative: Unsloth's June 18 v0.1.471-beta adds full GLM-5.2 coverage two days after that MIT-licensed ~753B mixture-of-experts shipped, plus an auto-fit memory algorithm credited with roughly 3x longer usable context. A sparse MoE activates only a fraction of weights per token, and exactly this memory-efficiency tooling is what pushes such a model toward a sub-256GB single-node envelope, reinforcing the thesis's underlying reason.
bridge.remaining_gap: No independently demonstrated single-node run of a frontier-class open-weight model under 256GB; today shows tooling, not a measured footprint.
